Name: (AT)Horror Movies Scarecrows
Author: Alexanderitedil
Description:
[b][size=5][u]More About This Mod[/u][/size][/b]

[size=3]     This is my first work as a modder！I tried to redesign the [/size][size=3]vanilla [/size][size=3]chartlets of scarecrows into my favorite horror movies' characters after simply learnt Alternative Texture t[/size][size=3]utorials.[/size][size=3]So there may be some bugs here, even though the code is a very simple.
[b]     
     About the bugs,you could post it in POST or just send me a message.[/b]BTW please overlook my grammer bugs since I'm not a native English speaker.[/size]
[size=3][b]   
    It requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿(AT).so make sure all of those are updated before trying to use this content pack.[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][b][size=5]How To Install[/size][/b]
     
      Download the file and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.My is [font=Tahoma][size=3]D:\steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods.(for reference only)

[/size][/font][b][u][size=5]How To Use
[/size][/u][/b][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]     
         Use [/size][size=3][url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][b].Just Use this tool to click the Scarecrow(vanilla,Scarecrow not Rarecrows) in your game and turn it into horror killers![/b]The same goes for the other tools in AT.Please check for [/size][size=3][url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki]wiki[/url].[/size]

[b][u][size=5]Q&A[/size][/u][/b][/color][list]
[*][b][size=4]Will there be more characters in the future update? [/size][/b]
[/list][b] YES.[/b][size=3]Just leave a message on the [b]POST[/b] and tell me what you want.[/size]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] compatible？[/size][/b]
[/list][b] YES.[/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Can I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿ to run this mod?[/size][/b]
[/list][size=3]Sorry,I don't know.I think it may need some minor adjustments to be compatible with CP.You can do it by yourself.I wrote this mod in the  environment of AT completely.[/size]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Can they have animations or interactive AI?[/size][/b]
[/list][size=3]First of all thank you for this valuable opinion, but unfortunately I am not yet capable enough to make such a module, but I am also interested in this idea, maybe in the future![/size]
